evidence.activity: In-house global product design team that designs the company's household appliances, a routine business input
evidence.quote: We have a dynamic, in-house global product design team located across the United States, the United Kingdom and China that collaborates seamlessly to integrate unique local market insights into the design and functionality of our products.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Scaled Engineering Powerhouse Focused on Disruptive Innovation and Continuous Optimization
evidence.indicators: over 700 cross-functional engineering and design associates

creativity.criterion: level 1: creative work (in-house product and industrial design) used only as a routine business input

creativity.reason: Level 1: design appears only as a routine input to making household appliances (E1), and 'storytelling' is brand marketing, which is a listed trap, so there is no creating or enabling of creative work.

community.reason: Level 1: rests only on general language (the 'People Positive' commitment to 'making a societal impact in all the communities' and culture values), and the filing has a people section of more than 150 words but describes no specific employee development, external education or community investment.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 1: rests only on the general commitment to 'fostering a culture of inclusion', with no specific internal practice, customer access or connecting-communities activity, and international offices and sourcing in Asia do not count.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: the filing describes only the company's own innovation and has no specific service or program enabling founders or small businesses.

ai.notes: Final score per formula: 7 + 6 + 4 + 3 = 20/100. Several trap terms were excluded. 'Storytelling' (Item 1 and Item 7) is brand marketing. 'Educate consumers' is marketing, not education. 'Global community of passionate brand ambassadors' (Item 7) is a customer base, not community activity. 'Accessible price points' refers to pricing, not accessibility. 'Accessibility' in Government Regulations is a legal risk mention. 'Design' here means product and engineering design. The 'seller/listing termination program' is anti-counterfeit enforcement, not a seller-enabling marketplace. 'Owner-operated factories' are suppliers, not an enabling program. The Positive Impact Plan activities described (refurbishing/remanufacturing, carbon offsets) are environmental and fall outside the four themes. The 'Built In' best-workplace award and the employee headcount (approximately 4,143 employees) are recognitions and disclosures, not activities. The Item 7 excerpts contained no qualifying activity. No second look is triggered because all themes are marked sufficient. The 10-K's people section discusses culture values only, so the Community cap of 2 would apply even if training were later disclosed.
